cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
if(CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR STREQUAL CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR)
    project(lmx_network_extra LANGUAGES C)
    set(LMX_NETWORK_EXTRA_STANDALONE ON)
    enable_testing()
endif()
set(_network_root "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}")
set(_network_vendor "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../vendor")
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 99)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_C_EXTENSIONS OFF)
set(CMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
set(CMAKE_POLICY_VERSION_MINIMUM 3.5)
set(CMAKE_POLICY_DEFAULT_CMP0077 NEW)
set(CMAKE_POLICY_DEFAULT_CMP0126 NEW)

function(_lmx_network_c99 target)
    set_target_properties(${target} PROPERTIES
        C_STANDARD 99 C_STANDARD_REQUIRED YES C_EXTENSIONS NO)
    if(CMAKE_C_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "GNU|Clang")
        target_compile_options(${target} PRIVATE -pedantic-errors)
    endif()
endfunction()

# Explicitly offline configuration. Upstream's C++/GTest suite is retained as
# source, but the compact default uses the self-contained C99 test below.
set(CARES_STATIC ON CACHE BOOL "LMX compact profile" FORCE)
set(CARES_SHARED OFF CACHE BOOL "LMX compact profile" FORCE)
set(CARES_INSTALL OFF CACHE BOOL "LMX compact profile" FORCE)
set(CARES_BUILD_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "LMX compact profile" FORCE)
set(CARES_BUILD_TOOLS OFF CACHE BOOL "LMX compact profile" FORCE)
set(CARES_THREADS ON CACHE BOOL "LMX compact profile" FORCE)
add_subdirectory("${_network_vendor}/cares" cares)
_lmx_network_c99(c-ares)
add_library(LMX::cares ALIAS c-ares)

find_package(Python3 COMPONENTS Interpreter REQUIRED)
set(_event_view "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/generated/libevent")
execute_process(COMMAND "${Python3_EXECUTABLE}" "${_network_root}/prepare_libevent.py"
    "${_network_vendor}/libevent" "${_event_view}" RESULT_VARIABLE _event_result)
if(NOT _event_result EQUAL 0)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Cannot create the reviewed C99 libevent build view")
endif()
set(EVENT__LIBRARY_TYPE STATIC CACHE STRING "LMX compact profile" FORCE)
set(EVENT__DISABLE_OPENSSL ON CACHE BOOL "LMX compact profile" FORCE)
set(EVENT__DISABLE_TESTS ON CACHE BOOL "LMX compact profile" FORCE)
set(EVENT__DISABLE_REGRESS ON CACHE BOOL "LMX compact profile" FORCE)
set(EVENT__DISABLE_BENCHMARK ON CACHE BOOL "LMX compact profile" FORCE)
set(EVENT__DISABLE_SAMPLES ON CACHE BOOL "LMX compact profile" FORCE)
set(EVENT__DOXYGEN OFF CACHE BOOL "LMX compact profile" FORCE)
# This upstream release forces CMAKE_CONFIGURATION_TYPES in the global cache
# even with Ninja. Restore the real generator configuration after inclusion;
# otherwise the next configure is falsely rejected by single-config adapters.
get_property(_network_multi_config GLOBAL PROPERTY GENERATOR_IS_MULTI_CONFIG)
set(_network_configuration_types "${CMAKE_CONFIGURATION_TYPES}")
add_subdirectory("${_event_view}" event)
if(_network_multi_config)
    set(CMAKE_CONFIGURATION_TYPES "${_network_configuration_types}" CACHE STRING "Configurations" FORCE)
else()
    unset(CMAKE_CONFIGURATION_TYPES CACHE)
    unset(CMAKE_CONFIGURATION_TYPES)
endif()
foreach(_target IN ITEMS event_core_static event_extra_static event_pthreads_static event_static)
    if(TARGET ${_target})
        _lmx_network_c99(${_target})
    endif()
endforeach()
if(TARGET event_static)
    # Upstream's legacy combined archive repeats core+extra. Keep the target
    # available explicitly, but do not build duplicate objects by default.
    set_target_properties(event_static PROPERTIES EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL TRUE)
endif()
add_library(lmx_event INTERFACE)
add_library(LMX::event ALIAS lmx_event)
target_link_libraries(lmx_event INTERFACE event_core_static event_extra_static)
if(TARGET event_pthreads_static)
    target_link_libraries(lmx_event INTERFACE event_pthreads_static)
endif()

add_library(lmx_mdns INTERFACE)
add_library(LMX::mdns ALIAS lmx_mdns)
target_include_directories(lmx_mdns INTERFACE "${_network_vendor}/mdns")
target_compile_features(lmx_mdns INTERFACE c_std_99)
if(WIN32)
    target_link_libraries(lmx_mdns INTERFACE ws2_32)
elseif(CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "Linux")
    target_compile_definitions(lmx_mdns INTERFACE _DEFAULT_SOURCE)
endif()

add_library(lmx_network_extra INTERFACE)
add_library(LMX::network_extra ALIAS lmx_network_extra)
target_link_libraries(lmx_network_extra INTERFACE LMX::cares LMX::event LMX::mdns)

if(BUILD_TESTING OR LMX_NETWORK_EXTRA_STANDALONE)
    add_executable(lmx_network_extra_check tests/network_smoke.c)
    _lmx_network_c99(lmx_network_extra_check)
    target_link_libraries(lmx_network_extra_check PRIVATE LMX::network_extra)
    if(CMAKE_C_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "GNU|Clang")
        target_compile_options(lmx_network_extra_check PRIVATE -UNDEBUG)
    endif()
    add_test(NAME network_extra.offline COMMAND lmx_network_extra_check)
    set_tests_properties(network_extra.offline PROPERTIES TIMEOUT 10)
    # Compile the upstream header-only library's complete example as a size
    # probe; do not run discovery or send multicast packets in this test.
    add_executable(lmx_mdns_size_probe "${_network_vendor}/mdns/mdns.c")
    _lmx_network_c99(lmx_mdns_size_probe)
    target_link_libraries(lmx_mdns_size_probe PRIVATE LMX::mdns)
    if(WIN32)
        # The upstream example enumerates interfaces with GetAdaptersAddresses.
        target_link_libraries(lmx_mdns_size_probe PRIVATE iphlpapi)
    endif()
endif()
